question: For whom is worship of one's own guru prescribed at all three times?
premises: One's own guru is the object named.
Worship is prescribed as an optative act.
That act is prescribed always and at three times.
The prescription is qualified by one of contemplative soul.
inference: One of contemplative soul should always worship one's own guru at the three times.
plain_english: One of contemplative soul should always worship one's own guru at the three times.
